Subject: VAT treatment for intercompany pass-through (invoice hold)

Hi Marissa,

We're seeing a payment hold on invoice LNX-9834 (PO 5590) due to VAT evidence — our AP team flagged that the invoice currently lists the UK reseller as the billed entity but the underlying purchase should be treated as intercompany pass-through to our EU operating subsidiary (Lumenix Netherlands B.V.).

To unblock payment we'd like to confirm whether Redwood can: 1) accept the attached VAT certificate for Lumenix Netherlands (attached), 2) reissue the invoice showing the EU entity as the purchasing party with a reverse-charge line (net amount + note), and 3) include our VAT registration number on the invoice.

Attached: lumenix_vat_certificate.pdf

Can you confirm the evidence you need and an ETA for a reissued invoice? Our AP target is to complete payment by 2026-08-03 if we can get the corrected invoice this week.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,

Hi Sofia — thanks for the note and the certificate. I looped in Kimberly (finance) and Rishi (legal/tax) so we can confirm the exact evidentiary requirements and the invoice flow. Quick summary of what we'll need to process and reissue: 

- Signed VAT registration or certificate for the purchasing entity (you provided — good).
- A short statement confirming Lumenix Netherlands B.V. is the purchaser for tax purposes for this transaction (one paragraph or an email from AP is fine).
- Confirmation of the place of supply (you indicate EU / NL).

Plan I'm proposing: Kimberly will confirm the accounting treatment and generate a reissued invoice flagged as reverse-charge (zero VAT) with the EU entity name and VAT number visible on the header and with an explanatory footnote. That should allow your AP to remit net amount only.

Action items for AP: please put the statement mentioned above into the Google sheet linked here so our team has a record: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-VAT-evidence (I created a row for Lumenix).

I'll ask finance to target a reissue by EOD tomorrow (2026-07-29) once we have the short statement. If you need faster turnaround we can escalate.

Marissa Cole
